name: Scutum
introduction: is the Shield, introduced by Johannes Hevelius in 1684 to honor King John III Sobieski of Poland after his victory at the Battle of Vienna. It is one of the few constellations named after a real person, and it lies in a bright part of the Milky Way.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Scutum contains one of the brightest patches of the Milky Way, the Scutum Star Cloud, where gaps in the dust let us see dense star fields thousands of light-years away.
The Wild Duck Cluster, M11, is one of the richest open clusters, with nearly 3,000 stars.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Alpha Scuti](hip:91117) is an orange giant. [R Scuti](hip:92202) is a pulsating supergiant whose brightness varies irregularly. [Beta Scuti](hip:92175) is a yellow bright giant.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: UY Scuti, a red supergiant in Scutum, is one of the largest stars known.
